title: GIG-3317: Strip DEFINER And Super Statements On MySQL Postmaclone Restore
description: Extends the MySQL dump sanitizer to strip DEFINER clauses and SUPER-only SQL_LOG_BIN / GTID assignments so Hydra restore can finish on DigitalOcean managed MySQL 8.

test_plan.description: Sanitizer strips DEFINER, SQL_LOG_BIN, and GTID without touching INSERT text
steps: Confirm view/trigger/procedure DEFINER clauses are removed and SQL SECURITY DEFINER remains
Confirm INSERT lines that mention DEFINER or SQL_LOG_BIN are unchanged
Confirm SQL_LOG_BIN and GTID_PURGED SET lines become ngramx comments
After release, dispatch factory produce and confirm Hydra restore passes line 7388

test_plan.description: SET matcher only comments dump session assignments
steps: Confirm INSERT ... SET and INSERT VALUES lines that mention SQL_LOG_BIN are unchanged
Confirm /*!40000 SET @@SESSION.SQL_LOG_BIN=0 */ is still commented out
